sources.excerpt: Dwarfcraft Devices Hair of the Dog - CUSTOM ENCLOSURE Brand New home | inventory | locate | sell | custom build | appraisal | knowledge center | http://www.distinctive-guitar.com/contact Inventory / Dwarfcraft Devices Hair of the Dog - CUSTOM ENCLOSURE Brand New Distinctive Guitar Dwarfcraft Devices Hair of the Dog - CUSTOM ENCLOSURE Brand New $249 Make Dwarfcraft Devices Model Hair of the Dog - CUSTOM ENCLOSURE Type Effects Condition BrandNew Case None Ask about this item Back to inventory Description Awesome Bass and Guitar Fuzz Pedal with built in noise gate controlled by the release toggle. There is also a control for the mix resulting in a fuzz pedal suited for both bass and guitar but makes it easy to dial in. Brilliant! The same coveted Hair of the Dog you love from Dwarfcraft, but we commissioned a small run of custom hand etched enclosures!! Get this awesome pedal before its gone and make a statement! Only 3 available - due to the hand made nature of this process, finish/design may vary slightly from pedal to pedal. From Dwarfcraft: OH YEAH! This is one of my pet projects from way on back. It’s descended from Eau Claire Thunder, but tweaked a bit to tear up your bass guitar, and of course, it will work on your smaller, wimpier instruments such as guitars or baritones or Casio keyboards. The bass friendly tones are helped along by a noise gate and a “low blend” allowing you to dial in some of your undistorted low tonez into your mix. Powered by Gbase
